parameters.query: WITH session_ok AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 FROM public.otp_codigos WHERE cedula=$1 AND usado=TRUE AND creado_en>NOW()-INTERVAL '20 minutes' LIMIT 1), person AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 'ESTUDIANTE' tipo,e.id source_id FROM public.estudiantes e WHERE e.cedula=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'DOCENTE',d.id FROM public.docentes d WHERE d.cedula=$1 LIMIT 1), existing_user AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT pu.id FROM public.parqueadero_usuarios pu JOIN person p ON (p.tipo='ESTUDIANTE' AND pu.estudiante_id=p.source_id) OR (p.tipo='DOCENTE' AND pu.docente_id=p.source_id) LIMIT 1), inserted_user AS (INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_usuarios(tipo_usuario,estudiante_id,docente_id,estado) SELECT p.tipo,CASE WHEN p.tipo='ESTUDIANTE' THEN p.source_id END,CASE WHEN p.tipo='DOCENTE' THEN p.source_id END,'ACTIVO' FROM person p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_ok) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing_user) RETURNING id), target_user AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM existing_user UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_user LIMIT 1), active_ticket AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT pp.id FROM public.parqueadero_pagos pp JOIN target_user u ON u.id=pp.parqueadero_usuario_id LEFT JOIN public.parqueadero_autorizaciones pa ON pa.pago_id=pp.id WHERE (pp.estado='PENDIENTE' OR (pp.estado='APROBADO' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN pp.fecha_inicio AND pp.fecha_fin)) LIMIT 1), plate_conflict AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,parqueadero_usuario_id FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos WHERE UPPER(placa)=UPPER($2) AND activo=TRUE LIMIT 1), demoted AS (UPDATE public.parqueadero_vehiculos SET es_principal=FALSE,actualizado_en=now() WHERE parqueadero_usuario_id=(SELECT id FROM target_user) AND activo=TRUE AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict WHERE parqueadero_usuario_id<>(SELECT id FROM target_user)) RETURNING id), updated_vehicle AS (UPDATE public.parqueadero_vehiculos SET tipo_vehiculo=$3,es_principal=TRUE,activo=TRUE,actualizado_en=now() WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM plate_conflict WHERE parqueadero_usuario_id=(SELECT id FROM target_user)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) RETURNING id,placa,tipo_vehiculo), inserted_vehicle AS (INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_vehiculos(parqueadero_usuario_id,placa,tipo_vehiculo,marca,modelo,color,es_principal,activo) SELECT u.id,$2,$3,'No especificada','No especificado','No especificado',TRUE,TRUE FROM target_user u WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) RETURNING id,placa,tipo_vehiculo), vehicle AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM updated_vehicle UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inserted_vehicle LIMIT 1), modality AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT pm.id,pm.precio FROM public.parqueadero_modalidades pm JOIN vehicle v ON v.tipo_vehiculo=pm.tipo_vehiculo WHERE pm.modalidad='DIARIO' AND pm.activo=TRUE AND pm.precio IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), inserted_payment AS (INSERT INTO public.parqueadero_pagos(parqueadero_usuario_id,modalidad_id,monto,metodo_pago,referencia,fecha_pago,fecha_inicio,fecha_fin,estado,registrado_por,origen_solicitud) SELECT u.id,m.id,m.precio,'EFECTIVO','YAVIBOT',now(),CURRENT_DATE,CURRENT_DATE,'PENDIENTE',(SELECT up.id FROM public.usuarios_panel up JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=up.rol_id WHERE r.codigo='ADMINISTRADOR_PARKING' AND up.activo=TRUE ORDER BY up.id LIMIT 1),'YAVIBOT' FROM target_user u CROSS JOIN modality m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) RETURNING id,estado,fecha_pago) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted_payment) success,CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_ok) THEN 403 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person) THEN 404 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) THEN 409 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict WHERE parqueadero_usuario_id<>(SELECT id FROM target_user)) THEN 409 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM modality) THEN 409 ELSE 201 END "statusCode",CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_ok) THEN 'La verificación de identidad expiró.' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM person) THEN 'Usuario no encontrado.' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_ticket) THEN 'Ya existe una solicitud o ticket vigente.' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plate_conflict WHERE parqueadero_usuario_id<>(SELECT id FROM target_user)) THEN 'La placa está registrada por otro usuario.' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM modality) THEN 'No existe una tarifa interna activa para este tipo de vehículo.' END error,(SELECT json_build_object('id',p.id,'codigo','TK-'||LPAD(p.id::text,4,'0'),'placa',UPPER(v.placa),'tipoVehiculo',v.tipo_vehiculo,'estado',p.estado,'fechaSolicitud',p.fecha_pago::text,'vigenciaHasta',NULL,'motivoRechazo',NULL) FROM inserted_payment p CROSS JOIN vehicle v) ticket;
